title: nuikit compiled theme (tokens v1, revision 1.1)
description: What compileTheme() returns and the nuikit resource publishes: every token, lowered so FiveM's browser can read it.

revision.description: Contract revision; "1.1" adds the identity tokens (optional in vars, so themes compiled by older nuikit stay valid)

card.description: Raised blocks on a full-screen surface

primary.description: The one main action per surface, progress fills, selection

muted.description: Tracks, slots and wells inside a panel

font-mono.description: Codes and IDs a player might type

warning.description: Caution status: low fuel, about to expire

hud.description: Surfaces drawn straight on the game: HUD chips, hotbar, target eye

scrim.description: Darkens the game behind full-screen screens, bar tracks and shadows on the game; always used with opacity

nk-scale.description: UI size multiplier (unitless). Players can scale further (0.85–1.25).

nk-motion.description: 1 = animations on, 0 = off. Painted as 0 when the theme or the player's reduced-motion pref turns motion down.

brand.description: The server's signature colour: active indicators, gauge needles, focus, logos (not the action: that's primary)

world-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn straight on the game, no panel (death text, unplated HUD values, nk-on-game). Light in every theme, light or dark

world-shadow.description: Text-shadow that keeps world-foreground legible over any frame

world-success.description: A gain drawn on the game or the HUD plate (slab deltas: +2, $250). Reads on the dark plate in every theme, light or dark

world-destructive.description: A loss drawn on the game or the HUD plate (slab deltas: −1)

font-display.description: Headings and big moments (titles, timers, the balance)

font-numeric.description: Every number on a gauge, money or timer (always tabular)

nk-type-ratio.description: Step between type sizes: 1.125 calm … 1.333 dramatic

nk-label-case.description: Captions (the short names of values) in uppercase or as written

nk-border-width.description: Hairline weight of panels, rows and fields

nk-cut.description: Chamfered corners (top left, bottom right), drawn with clip-path; 0 = off

nk-display-style.description: Display, heading, title and numeric text upright or italic (a real italic face where the font has one)

nk-pause-style.description: The pause menu: a full-height sheet, or a light slash panel with a diagonal edge into the scene

nk-pause-surface.description: The slash pause panel's light surface

nk-pause-ink.description: Text on the slash pause panel

nk-skew.description: Badges, chips, key caps, tags and the primary / selected bar drawn skewed (their text stays upright); 0deg = off, at most ±20deg

nk-surface-opacity.description: Panel opacity over the game (floor 0.92 for text panels)

nk-surface-tint.description: How much brand tints neutral surfaces (0–0.12)

nk-surface-gradient.description: Top-to-bottom light falloff on panels (0 = flat)

nk-surface-edge.description: Inner top highlight, the machined edge (alpha)

nk-elevation.description: Shadow recipe of floating panels: none, soft, deep, or hard (a solid offset drop, no blur; tokens 1.3)

nk-glow.description: Brand glow on active parts and HUD fills (alpha, 0 = off)

nk-density.description: Multiplies the kit's spacing scale: 0.875 compact (Graphite) … 1.15 roomy

nk-hud-opacity.description: Minimum backplate opacity of HUD chips and tiles

nk-hud-text-shadow.description: Shadow under text drawn on the game

nk-gauge-ticks.description: Tick marks on gauges: 1 on, 0 off

nk-row-indicator.description: How the active row is marked: bar, fill, outline, or sweep (1.5: no bar, the row's --nk-fill-tint sweep alone)

surface.description: Floating panel surface: popover tinted by brand (× nk-surface-tint); drawn at nk-surface-opacity

nk-elevation-shadow.description: The box-shadow nk-elevation names, in scrim colour

nk-hud-shadow.description: The text-shadow nk-hud-text-shadow names, in scrim colour

nk-clip.description: clip-path of panels: the nk-cut chamfer, or none when nk-cut is 0 (a clip-path would also clip the shadow)

nk-clip-sm.description: clip-path of chips, tiles and buttons: half the panel chamfer

nk-motion-feel.description: How the identity moves: crisp (Graphite), snap (Signal: no glide on selection, flash instead of press scale), smooth (Velvet: longer springs, a hint of bounce), stepped (Vector: values tick in steps)

nk-spring-bounce.description: Bounce folded into the snap, move and soft springs (0 = critically damped; 0.3 is the most the kit allows)

nk-motion-move.description: 1 = things may move (translate, scale, rotate, FLIP, stagger); 0 under reduced motion or off, where only fades of at most 100ms are kept

nk-time-instant.description: State that must be immediate: keyboard and controller selection, held key-repeat

nk-time-snap.description: The ladder (1.5): snap, 0.5 × d. A press, a rim switching state

nk-time-fast.description: The ladder (1.5): fast, 0.667 × d. Hover, a deny beat

nk-time-slow.description: The ladder (1.5): slow, 1.556 × d. A sheet or dialog opening, a confirm pop

nk-time-hover.description: Pointer hover colour and row background: 0.75 × d

nk-time-base.description: Panel and menu enter, the selection indicator, tab switch: d (kit.css --nk-time)

nk-time-exit.description: Every exit (panel, toast, menu, modal): 0.7 × d

nk-time-move.description: Toasts entering, FLIP moves, meters gaining: 1.5 × d, at most 300ms

nk-time-modal.description: Dialog enter (on an inner wrapper): 1.25 × d

nk-time-screen.description: Full-screen enter (pause, death, loading): 2.5 × d, at most 400ms

nk-time-ambient.description: HUD show-on-change fades and the damage trail; not scaled by the identity

nk-stagger.description: Delay per item on a list's first open: 0.15 × d (snap and smooth 0.125 × d), at most 20ms (smooth 30ms)

nk-stagger-max.description: Total stagger cap: items past the fifth enter together

nk-ease-out.description: Enter, hover, anything arriving: the identity's --nk-ease

nk-ease-in-out.description: On-screen moves (indicator, FLIP, tab underline) when not a spring

nk-spring-snap.description: Spring (duration, bounce): selection indicator, tab underline, needle catch-up

nk-spring-move.description: Spring (duration, bounce): toasts in, FLIP reflow, drawers, digit roll

nk-spring-soft.description: Spring (duration, bounce): full-screen content, large frame changes

nk-spring-pop.description: Spring (duration, bounce): rewards only (item added, level-up, a ×3 badge)

nk-treatment.description: How the palette is drawn: soft (Graphite), glass, plate or slab. Fills material, stroke, type, focus and motion defaults; any value the theme sets wins

nk-focus-style.description: Every component's focus (controller and keyboard highlight)

nk-hold-style.description: How a press-and-hold shows its progress

nk-confirm-scale.description: The short pop of a confirm

nk-level-style.description: How a level (--level, 0–1) is drawn by meters, vitals, holds, timers and cooldowns

nk-hue-line.description: Alpha of a role's line (borders, tracks)

nk-hue-tint.description: Alpha of a role's tint (fills behind text)

nk-hue-glow.description: Alpha of a role's glow (under the glow budget)

nk-hue-alert.description: Alpha of a role's alert wash (below the alert threshold)

nk-material-hud-opacity.description: Surface opacity of HUD parts drawn over the game

nk-material-hud-blur.description: Backdrop blur behind HUD parts drawn over the game

nk-material-hud-radius.description: Corner radius of HUD parts drawn over the game

nk-material-hud-edge.description: Inner top highlight of HUD parts drawn over the game (alpha)

nk-material-hud-texture.description: Texture over HUD parts drawn over the game

nk-material-menu-opacity.description: Surface opacity of menus, sheets and dialogs

nk-material-menu-blur.description: Backdrop blur behind menus, sheets and dialogs

nk-material-menu-radius.description: Corner radius of menus, sheets and dialogs

nk-material-menu-edge.description: Inner top highlight of menus, sheets and dialogs (alpha)

nk-material-menu-texture.description: Texture over menus, sheets and dialogs

nk-material-overlay-opacity.description: Surface opacity of full-screen overlays (pause, death, loading)

nk-material-overlay-blur.description: Backdrop blur behind full-screen overlays (pause, death, loading)

nk-material-overlay-radius.description: Corner radius of full-screen overlays (pause, death, loading)

nk-material-overlay-edge.description: Inner top highlight of full-screen overlays (pause, death, loading) (alpha)

nk-material-overlay-texture.description: Texture over full-screen overlays (pause, death, loading)

nk-backdrop.description: Backdrop filters (blur behind materials, the death screen's desaturation): off by default, because FiveM's NUI draws backdrop-filter as a black box over the game; on applies each surface's --nk-backdrop-filter (browser previews, clients that draw it right)

nk-slash.description: A decorative diagonal cut on menus, at most once per full-screen moment

nk-legibility.description: night: as designed. day: surfaces and hairlines lifted for a bright sky (not a light theme). auto: day while the game clock says so (html[data-nk-daytime], set by the HUD)

nk-legibility-lift.description: How far day closes the gap to opaque (0 none, 1 fully opaque)

nk-alert-threshold.description: A level at or under this is an alert (vitals, durability)

nk-notify-ms-info.description: How long a info notice stays

nk-notify-ms-success.description: How long a success notice stays

nk-notify-ms-warning.description: How long a warning notice stays

nk-notify-ms-danger.description: How long a danger notice stays

nk-rest-delay.description: How long an idle HUD part waits before it retracts (0 = never)

nk-motion-profile.description: full: as designed. reduced: no movement, short fades. instant: nothing animates

nk-ease-spring.description: An overshoot without a spring (confirm pops)

nk-time-confirm.description: A confirm pop: 0.65 × d, at least 60ms

nk-time-retract.description: A HUD part tucking away: 1.55 × d, at most 300ms

nk-time-fill.description: A level filling or draining: 3 × d

nk-z-world.description: Stacking layer: world. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-z-hud.description: Stacking layer: hud. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-z-scrim.description: Stacking layer: scrim. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-z-surface.description: Stacking layer: surface. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-z-dim.description: Stacking layer: dim. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-z-dialog.description: Stacking layer: dialog. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-z-system.description: Stacking layer: system. A modal is the current surface + dim + dialog

nk-focus-shift.description: The focused row's nudge toward its content

nk-glow-budget.description: How many elements may glow at once (the top surface's focused one first); 0 = no limit

nk-exit-factor.description: Every exit is this × its enter (--nk-time-exit = base × factor)

nk-time-reduced.description: The one reduced-motion duration: under reduced motion every fade is at most this

nk-pad-surface.description: Padding of a surface (dialog body, sheet column)

nk-r-key.description: Radius of keys and tiles (aliased by --nk-key-radius)

nk-r-chip.description: Radius of chips and badges (aliased by --nk-chip-radius)

nk-r-control.description: Radius of buttons, fields and rows (aliased by --nk-row-radius)

nk-r-surface.description: Radius of panels, sheets and dialogs

nk-h-key.description: Height of a key / small tile

nk-h-chip.description: Height of a chip / medium tile (aliased by --nk-chip-height)

nk-h-control.description: Height of buttons, fields and bar items / large tile

nk-h-row.description: Height of a list row (aliased by --nk-row-height)

nk-text-key.description: Size of the scan role (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-family.description: Font of the scan role (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-style.description: normal or italic, for the scan role

nk-type-scan-pad.description: Trailing pad of the scan role (the italic overhang)

nk-type-title-style.description: normal or italic, for the title role

nk-type-title-pad.description: Trailing pad of the title role (the italic overhang)

nk-type-label-style.description: normal or italic, for the label role

nk-type-label-pad.description: Trailing pad of the label role (the italic overhang)

nk-type-num-style.description: normal or italic, for the num role

nk-type-num-pad.description: Trailing pad of the num role (the italic overhang)

nk-type-body-style.description: normal or italic, for the body role

nk-type-body-pad.description: Trailing pad of the body role (the italic overhang)

nk-tile-ink.description: The legend on the face (aliased by --nk-key-fg)

nk-tile-plate.description: The solid plate behind the face

nk-tile-plate-x.description: How far the plate sits right of the face (0 = no plate)

nk-tile-plate-y.description: How far the plate sits below the face

nk-tile-press.description: How far a held tile presses toward its plate

nk-tile-skew.description: The face's slant (the box stays upright); at most ±20deg

nk-tile-confirm-face.description: The face when confirmed or active

nk-tile-confirm-ink.description: The legend when confirmed or active

nk-tile-hold.description: The hold fill over the face

nk-tile-active.description: The face of an active tile (data-active: the mic while talking, N on the compass, a checked box); a colour or a gradient

nk-tile-tag-delay.description: The tag opens this long after the tile lands

nk-plate.description: The plate colour (its channels, --nk-plate-rgb, are drawn at the context's material opacity)

nk-plate-drop.description: The plate's drop: hard, no blur

nk-fill-tint.description: The row sweep (a fill at level 1)

nk-fill-alert.description: The bar at or under the alert threshold

nk-accent-gradient.description: The accent paint: an active tile's face, the speedometer's level, the compass N, the heading's accent

nk-accent-from.description: The accent's first stop (SVG strokes: the speedometer arc, the lubber mark)

nk-lift.description: Row slide and slot lift on focus

nk-rise.description: How far things rise as they enter

nk-land-scale.description: The scale a tile lands from

nk-deny-x.description: The deny shake's distance (two beats of fast)

nk-vital-icon.description: Vital icons: each vital's own, or one uniform glyph

nk-vital-neighbours.description: What a growing chip does to its neighbours

nk-fill-style.description: How fills read: solid (flat, full, vivid: progress, meters, vital liquid, the selected row) or soft (translucent, a fading tint)

nk-row-gap.description: Between a row's icon tile, its text and its trail

nk-row-lift.description: How far the selected row's content slides in

nk-row-icon-box.description: The icon tile beside a row title (the icon inside is --nk-icon-md)

nk-row-marker-width.description: Retired in 1.7 (the selection is a Tile, SELECTION_TOKENS); read by nothing

nk-row-tint-reach.description: Retired in 1.7 (the soft selection is a tinted Tile face, --nk-tile-tint); read by nothing

nk-h-field.description: Height of text inputs, selects and dialog buttons

nk-focus-rim.description: A text field's caret focus (and a checkbox's or switch's lit rim): a single 1px rim. Nothing else draws focus (1.7)

nk-ring-segments.description: Segments in a progress ring (the speedometer's language)

nk-ring-gap.description: Degrees between a progress ring's segments

nk-tile-wall.description: The keycap's wall: how far the face sits above its plate (the primary button and the selection tile)

nk-tile-wall-shade.description: How dark the wall is under its face (0–1, the scrim over the face colour)

nk-tile-radius.description: The keycap's radius (the primary button and the selection tile)

nk-tile-key.description: The keycap face under --nk-fill-style: solid (the primary button, the lit row, the active tab)

nk-tile-key-rim.description: The keycap face's rim, --nk-border-width wide (the primary button and the selection tile); transparent = none

nk-tile-tint.description: The face's opacity under --nk-fill-style: soft (a tinted tile, the foreground ink)

nk-tile-inset.description: How far a selection tile sits in from its item's sides (room for the skew; never over a neighbour)

nk-tile-lift.description: How far a keycap's face rises on hover and focus (0 = flat)

nk-tile-press-ratio.description: How far a pressed keycap sinks, as a fraction of its wall (1 = flush with the plate)

nk-leading-tight.description: Line height of small text (captions, field labels, notice and row descriptions' tight lines)

nk-leading-normal.description: Line height of body-size text (rows, notices, slabs, row titles)

nk-row-bar-thickness.description: Width of the active row's bar (× nk-row-bar)

nk-row-bar-inset-scale.description: The row bar's inset from the row's top and bottom, in spacing units

nk-hold-ring-pad.description: Thickness of the hold ring around a key under nk-hold-style ring

nk-pip-size.description: Width of one pip under nk-level-style pips (a percentage of the bar: 10% = ten pips)

nk-meter-segment-gap.description: The gap between a segmented meter's segments

nk-glow-radius.description: Blur radius of a row's glow (a chip's is 0.75 of it, a meter's 0.625)

nk-list-gap.description: Between the items of a list: the wall plus breathing room, so a lit tile never touches the next row
